question: What is the rank of Sri Lanka in the Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3 (60)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sri Lanka ranked **60th out of 125 countries** in the **Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2023**, indicating a moderate level of hunger.
 
• The **Global Hunger Index** measures hunger and undernutrition across the world, using four key indicators: undernourishment, child wasting, child stunting, and child mortality.
 
• Sri Lanka’s score on the GHI 2023 was **13.0**, which falls in the "moderate" category on the hunger severity scale.
 
• Despite challenges such as economic instability and food insecurity, Sri Lanka has shown a relatively better ranking in comparison to many South Asian countries.
 
• The **Global Hunger Index** is jointly published by **Concern Worldwide** and **Welthungerhilfe**, which assess hunger comprehensively using internationally recognized data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Hunger Index (GHI):**

 
 
• The GHI is an annual report designed to track hunger globally, regionally, and by country.
 
• It uses a 100-point scale where 0 represents no hunger and 100 represents the worst level of hunger.
 
• The GHI focuses on four indicators: undernourishment, child wasting (low weight for height), child stunting (low height for age), and child mortality.
 
 
 
• **Hunger Severity Categories:**
 
 
• GHI scores are divided into five categories: low (≤9.9), moderate (10.0–19.9), serious (20.0–34.9), alarming (35.0–49.9), and extremely alarming (≥50.0).
 
• Sri Lanka’s score of 13.0 places it in the "moderate" hunger category.
 
 
 
• **South Asia and Hunger:**
 
 
• South Asia is one of the worst-performing regions in the GHI due to widespread food insecurity, poverty, and undernutrition.
 
• Countries like India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan rank lower than Sri Lanka in the 2023 GHI.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Sri Lanka:**
 
 
• Sri Lanka faces challenges like economic crises, inflation, and disruptions in food supply chains, which contribute to food insecurity.
 
• Despite these, the country has shown progress in reducing child malnutrition and improving food accessibility.
